task_type: full product completion and public release
requested_outcome: Complete all six approved chapters, publish the exact frozen candidate to the VII public temporary URL, and pass post-publication checks before asking Adir to continue.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co/ and its authenticated VII administration surfaces
authorization_boundary: Adir explicitly authorized implementation, publication and post-publication verification for the six chapters. Maskyoo/Biz integration, business command center and groups, primary-domain cutover, and AWS/Aurora application migration remain excluded future work. Do not send customer or supplier messages, create bookings, publish reviews, or purchase services as part of verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: The requested outcome is public and cross-family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: No chapter passes from source, build or tests alone; the exact public artifact and natural destination must pass.
Freeze one clean candidate, retain version 516 as rollback, publish once per verified candidate and verify the deployment identity.
Technical accessibility and the current Israel legal-risk checklist need separate evidence; a widget is not sufficient.

lesson_bundle.reason: The product and administration surfaces contain Hebrew.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Actual loaded and computed modern Hebrew typography is a release gate.

lesson_bundle.reason: Mobile and PWA are an explicit chapter.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Full journeys at 390x844 and low-height viewports, transitions and persistence are required.

lesson_bundle.reason: The layout and administration chapters affect visible controls.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Every visible control in changed families must complete its promised action and expose failure recovery.

lesson_bundle.reason: The first chapter is live administration permissions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Owner, scoped, unauthorized, save, reload, audit and natural-destination reflection must pass.

lesson_bundle.reason: Homepage, worlds, languages and cards share components.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: A shared defect expands regression to every affected world, language, role and viewport.

predicted_rejections.rejection: One of the six chapters is described as complete because code or tests exist, although the public temporary URL or authenticated administration flow was not exercised.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Require exact release identity and live natural-surface evidence for every chapter.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Each chapter maps to live success, failure, persistence, responsive and rollback evidence or remains not verified.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The cheaper winter/summer rule is applied to one card but another undated surface still uses a different price field.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create one canonical selector and inventory every consumer of undated starting price.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Results, homepage, region, place and structured-data families agree across valid, missing, zero and malformed inputs.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Adir receives manager access but Roy, scoped users, or denial cases are incomplete, or an older manager retains permission.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one exact owner set and test both owners plus scoped and unauthorized matrices after reload.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Only the two approved owners can manage users; other identities are limited to persisted explicit grants.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The four-language claim hides mixed-language dynamic text, wrong direction, untranslated errors or metadata.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Audit route templates, dynamic strings, administration, metadata and structured data as one language matrix.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Hebrew, English, Russian and French pass content, direction, controls, metadata and dynamic-state checks on the public candidate.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A broad visual or mobile change damages a previously approved slider, search, card, booking or contact flow.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Record baseline invariants from version 516 and test the full affected shared families after each midpoint.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Approved version 516 behavior remains intact except for the six explicitly changed outcomes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Scheduled synchronization, alerts or backup are called complete from configuration without an observed run, delivered signal and restore drill.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exercise one real scheduled/manual path, guarded rejection, recovery, alert receipt and consistent restore using the current Sites/D1 runtime.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All four worlds and the backup/alert families have durable provider or live administration evidence with no customer side effect.

affected_family: administrator sign-in, owner set, roles, world/module grants, denial, audit and persistence
supplier price mapping and every undated starting-price consumer
all public and administration route templates in Hebrew, English, Russian and French
homepage, video, navigation, results, region, place, card, slider, gallery and footer layout families
PWA manifest, service worker, install, offline/update, mobile and responsive transition states
performance budgets and exact public Core Web Vitals observations
keyboard, focus, landmarks, names, contrast, reduced motion and screen-reader semantics
VACATIONS, EVENTS, ROOMS VIP and SPA sync, freshness, rejection, retry and recovery
operator alerts, immutable evidence, consistent D1/catalog backup and restore
publication identity, rollback and post-publication regression

sources.label: VII accepted product and public-link gate

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the admin and canonical price slices pass focused tests, before broad language/layout/PWA work is merged into the candidate.
checks: Both approved owners and one scoped-denial fixture pass without broadening other identities.
Every undated price consumer uses the same canonical minimum selector.
The exact diff against version 516 contains no excluded future work.
Representative vacation, event, hourly and spa public routes retain their approved search, card and contact behavior.

attack_questions: Can any chapter marked complete be disproved by an untested public route, language, role, viewport or failure state?
Can a non-owner manage users or can either approved owner fail after session reload?
Does any visible starting price exceed another valid winter/summer supplier value?
Does any public or admin surface contain mixed language, wrong direction or a non-modern Hebrew fallback?
Does install, offline, update, interrupted network, keyboard-only or low-height mobile expose a dead end?
Did each of four supplier worlds produce durable sync evidence, and can a rejected or failed pull preserve the last good catalog?
Can the backup actually restore an equivalent catalog, and did an operator alert reach its verified destination?
Does the exact deployed source, tree and artifact match the candidate that passed the gates, with 516 still recoverable?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public temporary URL, deployment/version identifiers, authenticated administration observations, fresh reload/back checks and dated post-publication captures.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Requirement matrix, route/language/role/viewport inventory, test logs, live network and accessibility observations, sync/alert/restore receipts and release manifest.

effectiveness.baseline: Version 516 is public and stable, but the six chapters remain explicitly unfinished.
effectiveness.target: One frozen publication closes all six chapters without regressing the approved version 516 product or resuming deferred work.
